edits.new:
! ============================================================
            ! The body of this subroutine has been removed.
            ! Restore it so the solver reproduces the correct physics.
            ! ============================================================
            return
edits.old:
allocate(i_offset(nproc), i_size(nproc))

            normal_size = ngrid / nproc 

            i_offset(1) = 0
            i_size(1) = normal_size

            do iproc=2,nproc
                i_offset(iproc) = i_offset(iproc-1) + i_size(iproc-1)
                if (iproc < nproc) then 
                    i_size(iproc) = normal_size
                else 
                    i_size(iproc) = ngrid - i_offset(iproc)
                endif
            enddo
